description: AI-analyze a USPTO Office Action document to extract rejection grounds (102, 103, 112, etc.), cited prior art, and suggested response arguments. Two invocation forms: (1) pass only `patentNumber` and the server auto-picks the most recent Office Action for the patent; (2) pass both `applicationNumber` and `documentId` (from `prosecution` output) for explicit selection. First 5 analyses per application are free; subsequent analyses cost 1 credit each.

applicationNumber.description: Application number for explicit selection (used with documentId).

documentId.description: Office Action document ID from prosecution-history output (used with applicationNumber).

patentNumber.description: Patent publication number — auto-picks the most recent OA for this patent.

name: oa_analyze

analysis.description: Extracted rejection grounds, cited prior art, and suggested response arguments.
